Cloud Infrastructure Intern
Ridgeline Technologies

Join the platform team for six months. You will work on our deployment pipeline
and internal tooling.

Projects you might work on
- Reducing our CI build time, currently 22 minutes
- Adding monitoring and alerting to services that lack it
- Automating environment provisioning

Requirements
- Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field
- Comfortable on the Linux command line
- Basic scripting in Bash or Python
- Understanding of how HTTP and DNS work
- Familiarity with Git

Preferred qualifications
- Exposure to Docker
- Any experience with AWS, GCP or Azure
- Interest in CI/CD — we use GitHub Actions
- Familiarity with Terraform or Ansible
- Understanding of monitoring tools such as Prometheus or Grafana
